description: Land Title Settlement Department - Suriyapauwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510810 (24/0049)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration and determinations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed schedules of specific land parcels, their owners, property details, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, title determinations, and property ownership declarations without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
